g.text: KayaRank1Convo1 begins.
Hi. Can everybody time travel, or just you?
Good day to you too, listen kid, it’s not that simple.
Hello? Kaya? How is your day.
I'm not a kid. I'm 19.
Fine.
Right. Youngest of this new group I'd say, though, kid.
Yeah yeah, just don't rush into the time travel thing. It's... complicated.
So. Just you? Are there others? Is time travel taught in schools in the future?
Ugh. Youngest, sure, but also clearly most intent on doing something to find answers. Try and keep up. So: Time travel. How and who?
Ugh. How complicated? Formulas? Chemical and atomic elements? I'll figure it out just point me in a direction.
Let's say it's just me. Keeps it simpler.
And why you? Do you have a plan?
I don't really know what to tell you. It's not just the realm of science, or if it is, it's a science that Entrati knows.
Here's a direction: Stop [End.]
As for teaching in schools, if it was I didn't study it. But it might have been?
And if not, what can you recommend so I can get any scientific sources on your abilites?
Ugh that bastard. I knew I should have asked him more questions. Ok. At least if it's science, it means I can reproduce it, and since you can come and go, I can figure it out. Bye.
+20 Chemistry
Why, want some homework? Time travel is probably too advanced for now...
So many questions, kid. Hate to break it to you but: I don't know. Only Entrati has the answers.
+20 Chemistry

K.

Maybe Amir? He probably plays games with time travel plots...
Don't think so, kid. But if you want to learn something useful, ask Lettie for a 101 on healing.
+20 Chemistry
